title: DropSMP
description: Plugin for stats with a system of losing them by killing them. (Lite version)
body:
# 💎 DropSMP System [![Discord](https://i.imgur.com/HvQxAih.png)](https://discord.gg/vvnRgJMXvV) [![Discord](https://i.imgur.com/Re0ctmZ.png)](https://discord.gg/vvnRgJMXvV) DropSMP System is a perfect plugin for smp servers, after entering the server you will see 4 statistics. Strength, agility, resistance and speed. as your stats decline, your strength, resilience, or speed decline. If the stats increase, your character will be stronger, more resilient and will run faster.
---
# 🔥 Premium Always Better! [![Discord](https://i.imgur.com/Twuji3d.png)](https://discord.gg/vvnRgJMXvV) 🎥 **Preview:**
--- # ⚙ Functions ## 🆓 Lite Version - Statistics bar - Working stat decrease based on percentage - 50% chance to drop item after killing a player - Drop chance configurable - Killed player loses 10% of each stat (configurable) - Full plugin configuration - Customizable drop rewards - Protection against drop farming - Stat limits - Configurable ban system - Change stats after respawn - Change stats after ban - Full drop configuration - Optional glowing effect for drop items - Drop to ground or directly to inventory - Full emblem editing - Craftable insignias - Configurable insignia reset values - Editable emblem values - Fully customizable messages - Set player stats via file & command - Customizable stat bar display - Tombstone system - Configurable tombstone block - Editable particles in config - Unban command support --- ## 💎 Premium Version *(Everything from Lite +)* - Enable/disable texture pack - Automatic texture pack download - Custom icons in stats bar - Custom item textures - Change head material - Set custom Head-Texture directly - Use texture pack icons anywhere - Advanced custom item creator (separate editable file) - Editable benefits in custom items - Configurable benefit duration ---
# 🛒 Purchase Premium
- Discord: https://discord.gg/vvnRgJMXvV - Spigot: https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%AD%95-dropsmp-premium%E2%AD%90-drop-your-stats-when-you-die-%E2%AD%90-perfect-for-smp-%E2%9C%85.108439/ ---
# 🧩 Commands & Permissions
### `/dropsmp` - **Permission:** `dropsmp.use` - Main plugin command ### `/showdrop` - **Permission:** `dropsmp.showdrop` - Shows current drop rewards ### `dropsmp.newversioninfo` - Notifies player about new plugin versions ---
# 🛠 Config
[`*LINK*`](https://code.skript.pl/FeuRVSGz) ---
# 🔢 Placeholders
``` %dropsmp_speed% %dropsmp_protection% %dropsmp_strength% %dropsmp_agility% ``` ---
